source: Each maker's own Shopify store, its whole catalog read mechanically from /products.json, and each market's from the storefront its homepage's hreflang links name for it (Db's /en-us, /en-ca, /en-gb and, for Ireland, /en-eu; Dakine's /en-ca); a market without one isn't sold there. A bag's kind is what its title names (its store's product type where the title names none), a suitcase naming no size a carry-on to 45 liters, a medium to 90, a large past it; its liters what its title states, else the figure its text calls the capacity, else its text's one figure; its outside measure and weight only where its text states them. Its price is the regular one, the compare-at price where a sale shows one, the middle of its colors' where they differ, for a color still sold there. Prices in America and Canada are before tax, in Britain and Ireland with it.
